__comment: Port of Mantle 1.12's mantle:block/tinted_cube (NOTICE.md, MIT), the parent every connected-texture block model in the 1.12 generation sits on. The only thing it adds over a plain cube is tintindex 0 on all six faces, which is what lets a registered block/item color handler reach the geometry at all -- vanilla's block/cube_all carries none, so ForgeweaveGlassColors was never consulted (issue #951). Each face texture stays a separate key so the connected-texture models can bind a different frame per face.
